title: EarlyExit
description: A small Vanilla+ Minecraft Modpack for the Early Exit Platform
body: A fun & light vanilla+ Modpack for all those within the Early Exit community to enjoy that enhances the core experience without sacrificing its classic feel. Featuring quality-of-life improvements like Xaero’s World Map & Minimap for intuitive navigation, Tom’s Simple Storage for streamlined item management, and YUNG’s suite of structure mods to breathe new life into world generation, this pack keeps vanilla mechanics intact while making exploration, building, and survival smoother, richer, and more rewarding.
